about: Experience Jet Moto™ 2 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Extreme all-terrain racing on ten treacherous tracks
Master obstacles, catch more air, and perform challenging stunts in the most intense racing experience ever.
-Race through canyons, national parks, roller coasters and more
Improved polygonal graphics compared to Jet Moto

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: Experience Jet Moto™ 2 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
